newsitem.title: SPAIN: Sogecable signs cinema deal with Warner, Lusomundo.
newsitem.headline: Sogecable signs cinema deal with Warner, Lusomundo.

text.p: Spanish pay television giant Sogecable said on Wednesday it reached a deal with Warner Bros and Portuguese multi-media group Filmes Lusomundo S.A. to build and develop multiplex cinemas in Spain.

The group's objective is to put into operation 20 multiplex cinemas in the next four years. Each complex will have up to 16 screens and seating about 3,000, Sogecable said in a statement. Under the deal, the partners will set up a new group in which each owned a 33.3 percent stake. Warner Bros, part of U.S. entertainment group Time Warner, has 388 screens in eight countries.

The first of the Warner-Lusomundo multiplex cinemas, located just north of Madrid, has eight theatres and is already in operation. With this agreement, Sogecable is involved in the operation of this multiplex.
In addition, sites for other cinemas have been purchased at other shopping centres in Zaragoza, Valencia, Majadahonda and Valladolid, which will be opened over the next two years, Sogecable said.
